mathematical_review.subject: thm-geometrically-finite-subgroup-cusp-clear-sets-have-null-coset-translates
independent_checks: Checked right-coset representative normalization: replacing g by gj gives j^{-1}g^{-1}o in the subgroup Dirichlet domain while preserving gB. Escape/properness supplies ideal subsequences without ambient finite generation.

Recomputed hTh^{-1}: c_next=-c^2, a_next=1-ac, b_next=a^2,d_next=1+ac. For |c|<1 the upper bound max(|a0|,(1-|c0|)^{-1}) bounds a; c tends doubly exponentially to0 and matrices approach T, contradicting discreteness. Rescaling gives |ell c|>=1.
Verified orbit-height bound Y0/(|cz0+d|^2+|c|^2Y0^2)<=ell^2/Y0 for c nonzero. Full ambient stabilizer at a parabolic point is translational, so c=0 leaves the height Y0, including rank enlargement.
Independently checked Dirichlet exclusion of conical subgroup endpoints using a ray inside the convex Dirichlet domain and orbit points a bounded distance from that ray.

Rank-two Dirichlet comparisons bound both horizontal coordinates; bounded orbit height excludes convergence to infinity. Rank one bounds the real coordinate and forces imaginary escape; cusp clearance then sends B uniformly to infinity under affine height normalization. Compact stabilizer cosets transfer spherical shrinking.
Checked elementary trivial/parabolic/loxodromic alternatives and the full-sequence subsequence argument. No subgroup geometric finiteness was silently imposed on the ambient group.

mathematical_review.subject: thm-normalized-sphere-beltrami-solutions-depend-holomorphically-on-all-bounded-coefficients
independent_checks: Checked the complex-linear norm-one truncations and principal-to-three-point normalization. Injectivity ensures F_R(1)-F_R(0) never vanishes.
Verified the uniform finite-coordinate bound from inverse equicontinuity and fixed infinity, not just spherical boundedness.
Checked truncation convergence by equal-coefficient cancellation f_R composed with f^{-1}, holomorphic on the exhausting domains f(D_R), followed by compactness and normalized uniqueness.
Checked scalar circle integrals at arbitrary coefficient directions, Cauchy degree bounds M||nu||^n/r^n, dominated convergence and spatial equicontinuity giving C(K)-valued limits.

Recomputed complex multilinear polarization with the 2^n n! denominator: signed monomials survive only when each of the n inputs occurs once. Additivity and complex homogeneity pass pointwise, while the explicit norm bound (n^n/n!)M/r^n supplies continuity.

Verified passing the uniform tail inequality pointwise and then taking the spatial supremum yields a norm-convergent polynomial series uniformly on every smaller coefficient ball. No finite-dimensional or Banach-Vitali argument is substituted.
Checked infinity pullback by J(z)=1/z, spatial Cauchy derivatives on coefficient-zero patches, nonvanishing derivative and Schwarzian inversion locally in parameter.

Recomputed the three-point matrix B(u,v,w), whose values at0,1,infinity are u,v,w and determinant (v-u)(w-v)(w-u). Fixed target normalization and a local square-root series give the SL2 lift. No parameter-holomorphic family of inverse quasiconformal maps is assumed.
Read actual principal holomorphy, MRMT, compactness, composition/inverse, conformality and invariant-conjugacy proofs, plus the additional exact Cauchy–Beurling supplier used by principal holomorphy.
